reason: A DSH integration bundle that reuses a locally authenticated Grok Build CLI session, refreshes it through the official CLI, synchronizes an access token, and exposes a Grok subscription model route.

summaries.zh: 将本地 Grok Build CLI 的订阅登录接入 DeepSeek Harness，并同步访问令牌以提供 Grok 模型路由。
summaries.en: Connects a locally authenticated Grok Build CLI subscription to DeepSeek Harness and provisions a Grok model route using a synchronized access token.

capabilities: Reads the local Grok Build authentication session
Invokes the official Grok CLI to refresh authentication
Stores a short-lived access token in the DSH credential service
Configures a DSH provider route for the Grok Build subscription proxy
Sends requests to an external Grok service
